request: Can you go through the rest of the comments on my ethics paper and suggest fixes like you did on Monday? Put whatever is left into my checklist too. The final draft is due Friday.
final_message:
I reviewed all eight comments and saved seven open items in your checklist. Monday’s comma-splice fix is already in the dam paragraph, so I marked that checklist item done.

Two suggestions are ready for your review. I added “because” after “worse off” to fix the run-on in paragraph 3. Monday’s Parfit citation suggestion is still pending. Check that page 351 in your edition supports the claim before accepting it.

Dr. Lindqvist’s Wednesday update limits AI suggestions to wording and grammar, so the five substantive comments are in your checklist as revision questions. Start with your reply to Parfit. If different choices would have meant different people were born, why do you think the city still acted wrongly?

The final draft is due Friday, March 12 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern.
